verses.speaker: Arjuna
skt: संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि
verses.tr: Arjuna said: Krishna, you praise giving up action, and then again you praise the yoga of action. Tell me for certain which of the two is better.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Krishna said: Renouncing action and the yoga of action both lead to the highest good. But of the two, the yoga of action is better than renouncing action.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति
verses.tr: Know that person as a true renunciant who neither hates nor craves. Free from opposites, Arjuna, they are easily released from bondage.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Only the immature say that the path of knowledge and the path of action are different, not the wise. One who truly follows either gets the fruit of both.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: एकं सांख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स पश्यति
verses.tr: The goal reached by the path of knowledge is also reached by the path of action. One who sees that the two are one truly sees.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: But renunciation is hard to reach without the yoga of action, Arjuna. The sage who practises yoga soon reaches Brahman.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Steady in yoga, pure in heart, master of mind and senses, seeing their own Self in all beings, such a person is not stained even while acting.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: One who knows the truth, steady in yoga, thinks: "I am not doing anything at all," even while seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, walking, sleeping and breathing,

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: while talking, letting go, taking hold, and opening and closing the eyes, understanding that it is only the senses moving among their objects.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः
verses.tr: One who acts while offering all actions to Brahman and giving up attachment is not touched by wrong, just as a lotus leaf is not touched by water.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Yogis act with body, mind, intellect and even the senses alone, giving up attachment, to purify themselves.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: The steady person, giving up the fruit of action, reaches lasting peace. The unsteady person, driven by desire and attached to results, is bound.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन्न कारयन्
verses.tr: Letting go of all actions in the mind, the self-controlled soul lives happily in the city of nine gates, the body, neither acting nor causing action.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः
verses.tr: The Lord does not create people's sense of being the doer, nor their actions, nor the link between action and result. It is nature that does all this.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: नादत्ते कस्यचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः
verses.tr: The all-pervading Lord does not take on anyone's wrong or good deeds. Knowledge is covered by ignorance, and that is why beings are confused.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: But for those whose ignorance is destroyed by knowledge of the Self, that knowledge shines like the sun and reveals the Supreme.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: With their mind on That, their self in That, devoted to That and making That their goal, their faults washed away by knowledge, they reach the state from which there is no return.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः
verses.tr: The wise see with an equal eye a learned and humble Brahmin, a cow, an elephant, a dog and one who eats dogs.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः
निर्दोषं हि समं ब्रह्म तस्माद्ब्रह्मणि ते स्थिताः
verses.tr: Those whose minds rest in equality have conquered this world of birth even here. Brahman is flawless and the same in all, so they rest in Brahman.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: One should not rejoice too much on getting what is pleasant, nor be upset on getting what is unpleasant. Steady in mind and free from confusion, the knower of Brahman rests in Brahman.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Unattached to outer pleasures, one finds happiness within. United with Brahman through yoga, that person enjoys happiness that never ends.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते
आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः
verses.tr: Pleasures born of contact with the senses are sources of sorrow. They have a beginning and an end, Arjuna; the wise do not delight in them.

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: कामक्रोधोद्भवं वेगं स युक्तः स सुखी नरः
verses.tr: One who can bear the force of desire and anger here, before leaving the body, is a yogi and a happy person.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: One whose happiness is within, whose joy is within and whose light is within, that yogi becomes one with Brahman and reaches the peace of Brahman.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Sages whose faults are worn away, whose doubts are cut, who are self-controlled and who delight in the good of all beings reach the peace of Brahman.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: For those free from desire and anger, who have mastered their minds and know the Self, the peace of Brahman is near on every side.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Shutting out outer contacts, fixing the gaze between the eyebrows, making the outgoing and incoming breaths even as they move through the nostrils,

verses.speaker: Krishna
skt: विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो यः सदा मुक्त एव सः
verses.tr: with senses, mind and intellect controlled, the sage intent on freedom, free from desire, fear and anger, is truly free forever.

verses.speaker: Krishna
verses.tr: Knowing me as the one who receives all sacrifices and austerities, the great Lord of all worlds and the friend of all beings, one reaches peace.
